newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano's Chinese placement fails.
newsitem.headline: Giordano's Chinese placement fails.

text.p: Clothing retailer Giordano International Ltd said on Friday that a planned placement of new shares with five mainland Chinese enterprises had fallen through after the five failed to complete the deal.
Giordano had planned to issue 40 million new shares to the five enterprises at HK$4.90 a share, representing 5.3 percent of its enlarged capital, it said in a statement.
"All of the subscribers have failed to perform their obligations to proceed to completion of the placing," it said.

Giordano said the deadline for the five enterprises -- China Haian Enterprise Group Corp, China Haian Enterprise (Beijing) Group Corp, Tianxin Investment & Development Co, Dalian Sanding Economy Trading Ltd Co and Beijing Haian Aviation Service Co -- to complete the deal was April 22.
